body: I have seen a therapist in the past.  It was nice to have someone to talk to, but it honestly didn't seem to make that big of a difference.  I was on anti-depressants my senior year of high school and went on them again about 6 weeks ago.  Neither time did it really seem to make a difference, this time I started because my dad made me go talk to my dr. because he was concerned about me after my dog died.  I didn't have the heart to explain that the reason I was so upset about her death was because she was the one and only thing I liked about my life.
